title: The top k
description:
Find the k largest scores without sorting everything.

```
scores: 1000 random numbers
top 5 with a heap: 998 995 994 990 987
top 5 by sorting:  998 995 994 990 987
```
hints: The smallest of the current top k is on top of the min-heap, so it is the one to throw out (lesson 3.04).
`std::partial_sort` is the standard library's version; compare with it too.
requirements: Keep a min-heap of size k: push each score, and pop when the heap has more than k.
Print the result largest first, and check it against a full sort.
Use `std::mt19937` with a fixed seed for the scores.
stretch: Find the top k most common words in a text.
